about: Generated by papers/p1/termtable-collect.mjs from atom/tools/termtable.mjs output (runner run hund-f-and-terms); do not edit. The d- and f-block elements searched again with the neighbours' configurations as seeds, every settled candidate's energy corrected by its open subshells' Hund gaps (lowest term − lowest maximum-spin term), and ranked again. E_hartree and the ionization include the corrections; `uncorrected` is the same search without them; `bake` is atom/js/table.js.
